planner.note: scripted sequential obs-only stub, NOT a learned planner

verifier.backbone: policy's own frozen Qwen3-VL VQA P(yes)

skill_catalog.name: GRASP_OBJECT
skill_catalog.description: Grasp an object at a named grasp region and lift it clear.
skill_catalog.instruction: Grasp the blender lid securely at its handle and lift it clear.
skill_catalog.done_when: held AND lifted>=0.05m AND stable_for(20) AND no_disallowed_contact

skill_catalog.name: MOVE_OBJECT
skill_catalog.description: Move a held object to a named destination region.
skill_catalog.instruction: Move the held blender lid to the pre-place region above the blender while maintaining a stable grasp and avoiding disallowed contact.
skill_catalog.done_when: held AND at_target(xy<=0.06m,z 0.015-0.25m) AND stable_for(3) AND no_disallowed_contact

skill_catalog.name: PLACE_OBJECT
skill_catalog.description: Place a held object on a support, release, and retreat.
skill_catalog.instruction: Place the blender lid on the blender, release it after it is stably supported, then move the gripper clear.
skill_catalog.done_when: supported_by AND released AND upright_error<=7deg AND gripper_clear>=0.15m
